description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walgama North, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820013 (23/0015)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in the Matara district. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
